cases.label: the result keeps datetime's 3-digit precision and midnight exactly (no time-zone shift, no date-only value)
cases.reasoning: T-SQL CONVERT(datetime, '20030701', 112) gives a datetime at 00:00:00.000. The conversion returns TIMESTAMP '2003-07-01 00:00:00' as timestamp(3). A timestamptz return type, a session time zone, or a date return type would change the value or its type; the result-set comparison checks the value and the column type.
